name: Leonida Cartel
summary: Powerful transnational drug cartel with deep roots in Leonida State. Controls the Keys smuggling routes and finances high-end Vice City operations through shell companies.
description: The Leonida Cartel is the dominant criminal organization in GTA VI's world. Operating through legitimate-seeming businesses in Vice City and smuggling networks through the Leonida Keys, they represent both a threat and an opportunity for Lucia and Jason. Raul Bautista has historical cartel connections that complicate his loyalties. The cartel's Vice City leadership uses the Malibu Club area as a money laundering front.
territory: Leonida Keys, Vice City financial district, international smuggling routes
